name: Access Request
description: Consumer request to confirm whether a controller is processing the consumer's personal data and to access such data (§ 59.1-577(A)(1)).

name: Correction Request
description: Consumer request to correct inaccuracies in the consumer's personal data (§ 59.1-577(A)(2)).

name: Deletion Request
description: Consumer request to delete personal data provided by or obtained about the consumer (§ 59.1-577(A)(3)).

name: Data Portability Request
description: Consumer request to obtain a copy of personal data previously provided to the controller in a portable and, to the extent technically feasible, readily usable format (§ 59.1-577(A)(4)).

name: Opt-Out of Targeted Advertising
description: Consumer request to opt out of processing of personal data for purposes of targeted advertising (§ 59.1-577(A)(5)(i)).

name: Opt-Out of Sale
description: Consumer request to opt out of the sale of personal data (§ 59.1-577(A)(5)(ii)).

name: Opt-Out of Profiling
description: Consumer request to opt out of profiling in furtherance of decisions that produce legal or similarly significant effects concerning the consumer (§ 59.1-577(A)(5)(iii)).

name: Consent for Sensitive Data
description: Controller obtains the consumer's consent before processing sensitive data (§ 59.1-578(A)(5)).

name: Consumer Appeal
description: Consumer appeals a controller's refusal to take action on a request (§ 59.1-577(C)).
deadline: 60 days from receipt of the appeal

name: Data Protection Assessment Required
description: A processing activity listed in § 59.1-580(A) or (B) that triggers the obligation to conduct and document a data protection assessment.
